note: Authoritative unit registry, in soft-matter-agents' shape: multiplicative, si_factor converts to SI base units, dim is the dimension vector (L length, T time, M mass, Th temperature, A angle, N count, I electric current). Offset units (Celsius, Fahrenheit) are not registered: temperature is carried in kelvin and a reading given in Celsius is noted on the number. Rheology units (Pa, Pa.s, 1/s, N.m, rad/s) are here from the start because the first testbed is the rheometer and a rheology engine (plan.md 10). kDa is 1000 g/mol, so its si_factor is 1.0 kg/mol. Added 2026-11-16 (tasks/016), asked twice by sessions that built an engine agent: engine_length, for an engine's own lengths, and id, for a number that names and does not measure; neither has an si_factor. Added 2026-11-17 (tasks/016, run 20261117-4): engine_length^3, a volume in the engine's own units. Added 2026-11-17 (tasks/016, the person's word relayed from the clone of run 20261117-3): engine_energy, engine_time, engine_mass, engine_drag, engine_viscosity and engine_diffusivity, an engine's own units of each, none with an si_factor. engine_length^2 added the same day, for a mean squared displacement. Added 2026-11-17 (tasks/021, failure em-4; the paper-reproduction clone of run 20261117-11 asked for a speed): 1/engine_time, 1/engine_length and engine_length/engine_time, none with an si_factor.

engine_length.note: a length in an engine's own self-consistent units (HOOMD-blue's, a Lennard-Jones sigma); it has a length's dimension and no factor to metres until a request names the length scale, and a number in it is never converted by hand

engine_length^2.note: an area in an engine's own units, the square of engine_length (a mean squared displacement)

engine_length^3.note: a volume in an engine's own self-consistent units, the cube of engine_length (a particle's volume in HOOMD-blue's units); like engine_length it has no factor to cubic metres until a request names the length scale

engine_energy.note: an energy in an engine's own self-consistent units (HOOMD-blue's kT, a Lennard-Jones epsilon); no factor to joules until a request names the energy scale

engine_time.note: a time in an engine's own units (a step's dt, a lag); no factor to seconds until a request names the time scale

engine_mass.note: a mass in an engine's own units (a particle's mass); no factor to kilograms until a request names the mass scale

engine_drag.note: a drag coefficient in an engine's own units, mass over time (HOOMD-blue's gamma of Brownian and Langevin dynamics)

engine_viscosity.note: a viscosity in an engine's own units, mass over length and time (the eta of a Stokes drag 3 pi eta d)

engine_diffusivity.note: a diffusion coefficient in an engine's own units, length squared over time

id.note: an identifier written as a number, such as a random seed: it is set and compared, never added, scaled or converted

1/engine_time.note: a frequency or a rate in an engine's own units, the inverse of engine_time (Meep's frequency, in units of the speed of light over its unit length)

1/engine_length.note: a count per engine_length (Meep's resolution, pixels per unit length); no factor to inverse metres until a request names the length scale

engine_length/engine_time.note: a speed in an engine's own units
